notes:
REF-BM-02: No remote metadata collection or title/description/favicon/preview fields.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but it is not auto-collected and description is unsupported.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but description is unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are prevented and the existing card is focused, but the user is not taken into editing it.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title and tags, but not description or favicon.
REF-BM-08: A dedicated arrow link opens the URL, but selecting the list item/card itself does not navigate.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and note, but no description field exists.
REF-BM-14: #tag syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be stored and displayed, but markdown is rendered as plain text.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved-filter bundles exist.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
